title: Electronics workbench with soldering tools
visual_facts: A small circuit board is connected to several colored wires on a wooden workbench.
A black soldering iron lies along the right side with a white marking that includes SOLDERPRO 90.
Two spools labeled NIZU and SOLDER WIRE sit near the upper corners.
Blue-handled scissors, a perforated prototyping board, and small electronic parts are scattered nearby.
A small white rectangular board with two dark circular components lies near the bottom.
spatial_relations: The soldering iron and wire spools surround the circuit board and prototyping board.
uncertainties: The circuit's function and the identities of its components are not visible.
Some text on the spools is too small to read fully.
